question_text: A factory in Laguna is found to be emitting dark smoke from its chimney without any pollution control device. Under RA 8749 (Clean Air Act), which of the following is a correct statement regarding the prohibition on incineration?

options.text: Incineration is completely banned for all types of waste, including medical and hazardous waste.
Incineration is allowed for municipal solid waste as long as the facility has a permit from the DENR.
Incineration is prohibited only for agricultural waste; industrial waste may be burned with a permit.
Incineration is allowed for all types of waste if the burning temperature exceeds 1,000°C.
